title: Cotton Floral Printed Top & Wide Leg Palazzo Co-ord Set
description:
Chandrika means “moonlight” – soft cream florals with a gentle glow.

Ivory cream cotton floral printed top and palazzo set featuring a sleeveless V-neck peplum top with delicate white lace detailing and a flared hem. The top has mustard brown, olive green and turquoise floral prints, paired with light cream wide-leg palazzo pants. A comfortable two-piece outfit for everyday wear, casual outings and vacations.
care: Gentle hand wash in cold water. Wash separately, do not bleach and dry in shade.
